newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico City gets new top cop.
newsitem.headline: Mexico City gets new top cop.

text.p: The Mexican government on Thursday appointed lawyer Lorenzo Manuel Thomas Torres as Mexico City's new attorney general.
Thomas, 52, took over from Jose Antonio Gonzalez Fernandez, who resigned Feb. 7 to campaign for the candidacy of the ruling Institutional Revolutionary Party (PRI) for mayor of the capital.
The PRI chose veteran politician Alfredo del Mazo to run for mayor in July elections instead of Gonzalez, who was widely seen as the preferred candidate of President Ernesto Zedillo.
Thomas, who is originally from the northern border city of Tijuana, was until Thursday district director of legal affairs.
